full_prompt_en: The image is a square cinematic photorealistic close-up of a bearded man in a helmet and communication headset, rendered in subdued olive, charcoal and warm brown. The background falls almost completely into black, visible mainly as a narrow area on the left beside the face. A scratched grey-green helmet cuts across the upper frame, with straps, mounted hardware and dark recesses along its rim. At the upper right, an olive ear cup has rubbed edges and small surface abrasions. A slender microphone arm curves diagonally from the headset across the dark beard toward the mouth. The man turns his face slightly left while looking intently toward the viewer, his pale blue-grey eyes catching small clear reflections beneath the shadowed brow. Warm light reveals rough skin, dirt marks and fine creases across the nose and cheek. Grey strands run through the thick dark beard, with individual hairs separating at the edges. Across the lower right, a heavy charcoal outer layer and tan straps overlap in broad diagonal folds, their woven surfaces dulled by wear. A cropped dark cylindrical piece of equipment rises at the lower-left edge, partly lost in shadow. Soft directional light from the upper front-left defines the facial planes and worn raised surfaces, while deep occlusion shadows gather beneath the helmet, within the beard and between fabric layers. The overall composition is dense and intimate, using selective sharpness, muted natural colour and tactile material detail against a nearly empty dark field.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形电影式写实特写，戴头盔及通信耳机的胡须男子以低饱和橄榄绿、炭灰与暖棕呈现。背景几乎完全沉入黑色，主要只在脸旁左侧露出狭窄区域。带刮痕的灰绿头盔横过上缘，帽沿周围分布带子、安装配件和深凹处。右上方的橄榄色耳罩有擦损边缘和小片表面磨痕。细长麦克风杆从耳机斜向跨过深色胡须，伸向嘴边。男子的脸略朝左转，目光专注地朝观者看，浅蓝灰眼睛在眉下阴影中带小而清楚的反光。暖光显出鼻子与面颊上的粗糙皮肤、污痕和细褶。浓密深色胡须中夹杂灰色发丝，边缘可见分开的单根毛发。右下方，厚重炭灰外衣与棕黄色带子以宽斜褶层叠，织物表面因磨损而显暗哑。左下缘有被裁掉一部分的深色筒状装备向上伸出，局部隐藏在阴影里。来自左前上方的柔和定向光界定脸部转折及磨损凸面，头盔下、胡须间和衣料层间则积着深重遮蔽阴影。整体紧密而贴近，以选择性清晰度、克制自然色和可触材质细节，对照近乎空白的暗场。
style_prompt_en: Cinematic photorealistic rendering combines selective crisp focus with deeply recessed shadow and densely observed surface texture. Muted olive, charcoal and warm earth tones retain small cool accents, avoiding broad areas of bright saturated colour. Fine pores, fibres, scratches and rubbed edges differentiate rough, woven and hard surfaces through localized detail. Soft directional upper-front light reveals raised planes and small reflective points, while contact areas fall into dark occlusion. Tight cropping and overlapping diagonals compress the composition, with a nearly black surround isolating the focal mass. The overall effect is weighty and immediate, balancing naturalistic colour, worn material realism and controlled low-key contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 电影式写实渲染将选择性锐利焦点、深凹阴影与密集表面观察结合起来。低饱和橄榄绿、炭灰和暖土色保留少量冷色点缀，没有大块鲜艳高饱和色。细孔、纤维、刮痕及擦损边缘通过局部细节区分粗糙、织物和硬质表面。前上方柔和定向光显出凸面及小反光点，接触区域则沉入遮蔽暗影。紧密裁切与交叠斜线压缩构图，近黑周边隔离主要体量。整体厚重而直接，在自然主义色彩、陈旧材质真实感与受控低调反差之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A bearded helmeted man looks toward the viewer in a tightly cropped, weathered tactical portrait.
theme_zh: 戴头盔的胡须男子望向观者，构成紧密裁切、满是磨损质感的战术肖像。
name: Call of Duty
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
